game.title: Quantum Break
game.blurb: Third-person action shooter about time powers from Remedy Entertainment (RAWG lists Microsoft Studios and THQ Nordic as publishers), released 2016-04-05. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story
chapters.summary: Five acts and the story moments along the way, all hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Time Powers in Combat
chapters.summary: Time Blast, Dodge Focus, Time Rush, Time Stop, Time Shield, chronon harnesses and explosions.

chapters.title: Upgrading Time Powers
chapters.summary: Upgrading a time power, then fully upgrading one and finally all of them.

chapters.title: Intel, Quantum Ripples and the Show
chapters.summary: Intel Items, Quantum Ripples, e-mails, radios, posters, show episodes, Paul's presentation and 100% completion.

chapters.title: Difficulty
chapters.summary: Finishing the game on Casual, Normal and Hard.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 474960 ("Quantum Break") was used. The store list has a second app also named "Quantum Break" (4354330); the Steam API refused its schema (HTTP 403), so what it is could not be told from the data. 21 of 42 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter; five have API names ACH_ACT1_COMPLETED to ACH_ACT5_COMPLETED, which is the only source for "five acts". The other 16 hidden ones could be story moments or choices; the data does not say which act each belongs to. No StrategyWiki page under "Quantum Break". quantumbreak.fandom.com redirects "Quantum Break" to a disambiguation page that lists "Quantum Break (video game)", "Quantum Break (Windows 10)", "Quantum Break: Timeless Collector's Edition" and the TV series; "Quantum Break (video game)" answers the API with about 131 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
